# 0.1.4 — threat.actors objects and generate crash

13 September 2026. Patch on the public **0.1.3** beta.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.1.4
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Fixed

- `threat.actors` is a list of objects (`name` is a scoped actors-vocabulary ID such as `att&ck::G0006`; optional `sighting` and `references`). Generated JSON Schema no longer teaches `list[str]` ([#172](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/172)).
- `opentide generate` no longer crashes with `'str' object has no attribute 'get'` when exporting actors.
- Nested vocabulary fields (threat leverage / viability, objective composition) are validated against the pinned vocabs.

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide generate
opentide validate --strict
```

Expect `0.1.4`. Author actors as objects:

```yaml
actors:
  - name: att&ck::G0006
```
